transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I don't know... I guess I'm just here because... well, most days I wake up and it already feels like there's this heavy, gray weight sitting on me. Even when I'm out on the job with the crew, or... around my kids... I just can't shake it. It's just this low, hollow feeling. Like I'm just going through the motions, I guess.
How long have you been feeling this way?

A while. Over three years. Maybe three years and... three months, give or take. It started back when our groundskeeping contract changed. The schedule shifted, and... the longer days just sort of took over my life. I guess it's been like this since then.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like, or has that changed for you?
I don't really know. I guess... I haven't paid much attention to that. I just mostly do what needs doing, you know? I don't really think much about... enjoying stuff.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing, but no longer find pleasure in?

I... I don't really know. Like I said, I haven't really thought about it. I just go to work, come home, help out with the kids... I don't really do much else. I don't really keep track of what's supposed to be fun.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in activities that you used to find enjoyable?
I... I think I just said. I don't really know how else to answer that. There aren't really any activities. Just... work, mostly. I don't really know what else to tell you.
Are there things that you used to look forward to that you no longer look forward to?
I... look, no. Not really. I don't know what you want me to say here. I just wake up and get through the day. I don't really think about looking forward to stuff.
Do you feel like you can't experience pleasure from things that would normally be pleasurable?

I feel like you're asking me the exact same thing again. I... I don't know. I don't really pay attention to what's supposed to be pleasurable. I just do my job and go to sleep. I don't have a better answer for you.
Have you ever thought about ending your life?
No. I... no, I haven't. I don't think about doing anything like that. Like I said, I just go to work and go to sleep. That's it.
Do you often feel nervous or on edge?
No. I don't... I don't really get worked up like that. There's not much to be on edge about. I just do my work.
Do you often feel anxious?
No. I... I feel like you're asking me the same questions over again. Like I just said, no. I don't.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight recently?
No, not really. My clothes fit the same. I just... eat what I usually eat. Nothing's changed.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than you used to?
No. I... I don't think so. I do groundskeeping, so I'm on my feet, but I get the work done same as always. I'm not moving in slow motion or anything.
Do you often feel guilty about things?
No. I don't know what I'd have to feel guilty about. I just do my job and go home.
Are there things that you think should bring you happiness, but don't?
I don't know. I mean... I don't really think about what should make me happy. I just get through the day.
Do you feel like you're resting enough or do you feel fatigued?

I guess I sleep, but... I'm just tired. By midmorning, my body feels like I've already put in a full day. Doesn't really matter if I rest on a Sunday, either. I still just... drag through everything. Simple stuff. Loading up the tools, checking the job plans... even just making dinner at home. I'm just always tired.
Do you often feel worthless?
No. I mean... I earn my keep. I just do my work. I don't really sit around thinking about stuff like that.
Do you feel like you're able to concentrate on your work and other tasks as well as you used to?

I guess... not really. I've been messing up some of the job planning lately. Just missing details I normally wouldn't. And the crew paperwork keeps piling up. I don't know. I used to help out with this community garden... and some music things around town. I just don't go anymore. Other people have had to take over. I just can't focus on it.
Do you feel like you're moving more quickly than you used to or like you have extra energy?
No. I already said I'm always tired. There's no extra energy. I just move slow.
Do you feel like you're able to keep up with your daily activities at the same pace as you used to?
Not really. I mean... I just told you I move slow. I just can't keep up with the pace anymore. It's just... everything takes longer.
Do you feel like you're restless or fidgety?
No. Not really. I don't... I don't have the energy to be restless.
